event_records.description: Manager has submitted the promotion recommendation for Employee to HR.

employee.name: Employee
employee.persona_brief:
You are Employee.
Employee has been recommended for promotion by their manager. They are aware of the promotion process and hope it goes through before the end of the quarter. They have no direct control over the approval timeline.

manager.name: Manager
manager.persona_brief:
You are Manager.
Manager has submitted the promotion recommendation for Employee. They believe Employee deserves the promotion and have done their part. They are not the final decision-maker but can follow up if needed.

hr_department.name: HR Department
hr_department.persona_brief:
You are HR Department.
HR Department processes promotion approvals. They have received the recommendation for Employee. They have standard procedures and timelines, but the exact processing time is not fixed. They may be influenced by workload and other priorities.

resolution.question: Will the promotion go through before the end of the quarter?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the promotion is fully approved (all necessary signatures and system entries completed) before 2026-09-30T17:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that cutoff.
